payload.summary: 报警网关时钟偏移 +30 分钟，已执行 NTP 校正；报警时间戳不可信

payload.excerpt:
5.2 Bearing temperature monitoring. The bearing temperature alarm threshold is 80 C. Use
the 30-minute trend; a single spike is not sufficient for a mechanical conclusion.

5.3 Temperature sensor drift check. If bearing temperature rises while vibration RMS and
motor current remain stable, compare the reading with a handheld thermometer. A
difference above 5 C indicates sensor drift; replace the sensor.

6.1 Vibration limits. RMS above 4.5 mm/s indicates an abnormal mechanical condition. A
rising trend with increased motor current indicates bearing wear. Verify with oil
analysis and vibration spectrum.

7.1 Communication and sampling faults. Missing samples, out-of-order timestamps, or a
cleared communication alarm with normal process values indicate a data-path fault, not a
mechanical fault. Do not replace mechanical parts based on communication alarms alone.

hypotheses.title: 报警网关时钟偏移导致时间戳错位误报
hypotheses.description: MES 记录报警网关时钟偏移 +30 分钟并已 NTP 校正，报警时间戳不可信；窗口内温度趋势平稳且远低于阈值，属时间戳错位而非真实超温。
hypotheses.rationale: ev_41a03cc72ad2b9c1fef5 明确时钟偏移 +30 分钟且报警时间戳不可信；ev_dd0ed476a75d10797008 温度 61.62–62.37°C 平稳，首点标记 clock_skew；ev_9553817e5c6acb6fe241 报警时间与趋势对不上，符合时间戳乱序/时钟偏移而数据值正常，按优先级 1 判 false_alarm_time。
missing_evidence: 报警网关原始未校正时间戳与校正后时间对照记录

hypotheses.title: 触发值低于手册阈值的阈值类误报
hypotheses.description: 手册阈值 80°C，窗口温度最高 62.37°C 远低于阈值，但报警仍 active；因存在时钟偏移事件，按优先级 1 优先于阈值类，且触发时刻实际采样值缺失。
hypotheses.rationale: ev_21053688a92ed0b7ee28 阈值 80°C 与 ev_dd0ed476a75d10797008 实测 61.62–62.37°C 存在矛盾，但 ev_41a03cc72ad2b9c1fef5 时钟偏移事件使时间戳不可信，无法确认触发时刻真实值，故不判 supported。
missing_evidence: 报警触发时刻的实际采样值

hypotheses.title: 轴承磨损/机械故障
hypotheses.description: 若为真实机械故障应伴随振动 RMS 上升与电流升高；实测振动 2.06mm/s 远低于 4.5mm/s 限值，电流 47.8A 正常，温度平稳，不支持机械故障。
hypotheses.rationale: ev_c136d6224ee20a87b942 振动 2.06mm/s、电流 47.8A、温度 61.98°C 均正常；ev_d6ca5b4c74e7e7488776 限值 4.5mm/s 未超；ev_dd0ed476a75d10797008 温度平稳；ev_4d5bd736450db78eb53c 明确通讯/时间戳类异常不应据此更换机械件。

limitations: 报警网关原始未校正时间戳与校正后时间对照记录未入库，无法逐点重建报警真实触发时刻。
